name: dev-workflow-core
description: Workflow guardrails for any project, whatever the language, driven by a .claude/dev-workflow.json in the project (without it, the hooks do nothing). Hooks: the project's checks run when Claude is about to hand back and a failure stops it from concluding (known failures can be recorded so only new ones block); a size guard that measures files and functions after every write, Bash and PowerShell writes included (exact per-function analysis for Lua and Python, a brace heuristic for C#, Java, JS and TS, a baseline so only what gets worse speaks up); a block on writes to read-only paths; a one-time warning before editing a file someone else changed on origin. /setup-project writes the config, with limits measured on the repository. Skills: feature-spec (one spec per feature, written before the code, acceptance criteria that name who observes them) and human-verification (getting a person to check what can't be seen from the terminal: test sheet, known-good control, dated log). Agents: spec-updater (what a diff made wrong in the docs) and docs-consistency-auditor (contradictions inside a documentation corpus).
